'''2018 US Nationals Jeremy DiPaolo LS Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jeremy DiPaolo]] at [[2018 U.S. National Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jeremy DiPaolo]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 U.S. National Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan / A Weakness Can Be Found|V3-L-diplomaticmissiontoalderaan.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan 14.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-us-nationals/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127141216/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-us-nationals/ Internet Archive]
